plugins.name: plc-tia
plugins.description: A reusable toolkit for driving Siemens TIA Portal V17 through the Openness API — connect/read/export, device cloning, tag creation, FB wiring and standard + safety (F) chain imports. v1.5: all recipes as the TiaSharp C# console tool (dry-run/confirm, attach-once shell, order notes); PowerShell scripts remain as v1.0 reference.
